test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: 'Penalty Corner' is related to which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hockey.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Penalty corner** is a term used in the **sport of hockey.**
 
• It is a set piece where the** attacking team** gets a free hit from the **10-yard line** with only the **goalkeeper and four defenders** allowed to **defend the goal.**
 
• Penalty corners are usually awarded for **fouls committed **by the** defending team **inside their own circle.
 
• Penalty corners are considered to be a **crucial opportunity** for the attacking team to **score a goal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chess** is a** board game** that involves **strategic thinking and planning**, and has no connection with penalty corners.
 
• **Tennis** is a **racket sport **where players hit a ball over a net and points are scored based on the **opponent's inability to return the ball.**
 
• Penalty corners are** not used **in tennis.
 
• **Badminton** is a **racket sport** played with a **shuttlecock and a net**.
 
• Penalty corners are** not** used in badminton.
